text: That afternoon: Holmes says they will spend the night in her room and investigate the noise
why: Holmes and Watson arrived in the afternoon (¶125–126), and in ¶188 he says they will spend the night in her room and investigate the noise.

text: What will happen in the middle room to-night? — only the noise that disturbed her, with some harmless cause
id: q.tonight=only the noise that disturbed her, with some harmless cause
why: A plain possibility raised by Holmes's talk of investigating 'this noise'; earlier innocent explanations were offered (gipsies, gale, creaking house), and it reveals nothing new.
